_about: Canonical prompt blocks for the Ghost Ship / Skyglass / Crownhold collection (ART_BIBLE.md section 10). state/skyglass_art/build_art_batch.py pastes these verbatim; edit here, never in a generated prompt. Anchor: the original crew, Deck Warden to the Crowned Captain (RUL-2026-10-26-002).
style_character: Style: Edo-era Japanese fantasy ninja, premium pixel art matching the original Skyglass crew: crisp hard-edged pixels at medium-high density, clean dark outlines about one art pixel wide, flat cel shading in two or three steps per material, limited palette, no airbrush, no bloom, no painterly gradients. Colour: near-black and deep indigo cloth; skyglass cyan along the weapon's edge and in the eyes; brass on only one or two small fittings; rope only at the belt. Build and pose: lean, tall and agile, in a battle-ready stance with the weapon drawn; the sash tail and torn hems trail with movement. Camera at eye level, front three-quarter view, full body inside the frame with a clear margin, grounded adult proportions, both arms within the silhouette.
costume_character: Costume: the crew's four marks: a hood or hat, a cloth mask over nose and mouth with eyes lit by pale chakra, an indigo sash with a hanging tail, and cloth-wrapped shins over closed tabi boots; dark layered kimono and plain lacquered plates where the subject asks for armour. Solid gloved hands with five fingers. Period weapons only.
impression: He is a solid shinobi recalled as a chakra impression; the only signs are chakra-lit eyes and a faint haze of the accent colour at the cloth's torn edges.
chakra: Any chakra is a compact flame-like glow along a weapon's edge, or a small ball of chakra held above an open gloved palm; the hand is drawn normally.
negative_character: Negative: no modern or sci-fi objects, no machines, cables or glowing panels, no glowing seams or veins, no translucent, crystal or ghost body parts, no floating parts, no thread or line from the head, no gold, no filigree, no tassels, no crown, no ornate parade armour, no headband, no forehead protector, no clan or village symbol, no text, no bare toes, no aura or halo, no realistic or smooth painterly rendering, no anime-scaled eyes, no blur, no scenery, no floor, no cast shadow on the key colour, no key-colour spill, no second character, no undead imagery (no rot, bones, skulls or grave motifs), no sheet, no grid.
key_avatar: On a true solid flat magenta chroma key background (#FF00FF) covering the entire canvas, not transparent, not checkerboard. Square 1024 x 1024.
commander: Commander presence: clearly a commander: taller than a regular with a longer, heavier cloak or haori and a high collar, not wider or stockier; a commanding, battle-ready stance. Still no gold and no crown.
reference_character: STYLE: the original crew's look (rendering, palette, outline weight, outfit language and proportions); this is a different person, whose head, gear and weapons are described by the text
